findings.detail: Server-rendered explore search via /explore-media/?s=<term> returns 404 on Reign (works on BuddyX). Plugin reads the reserved `s` query var (explore.php:190) on a page URL; WP core turns ?s=nonempty into is_search() which 404s with the page+search combo on this theme. REST search (GET /mvs/v1/media?search=) works 200 - the mandatory app path is unaffected. Pre-existing, not introduced by the 1.8.0 CSS audit. Fix: use a non-reserved query var (mvs_s) or pre_get_posts guard.
